03 / Choreography directions

Three ways to
make it move.

Same song, three points of view. Pick a creative brief before the character takes the stage.

01 / GROOVE

Grounded Groove

Low center of gravity, precise footwork and a continuous street-dance pulse.

STREETMEDIUMSTAND / SIT
02 / RELEASE

Neon Release

Big shapes, quick changes and a chorus that breaks out of the frame.

03 / GRAVITY

Soft Gravity

Long lines and liquid transitions that let the warmer layers breathe.

LYRICALFLUIDFLOOR
Creative brief

Why these three?

The report found a stable 120 BPM pulse, a bright emotional center and a visible energy lift in the chorus. Each direction keeps the beat map intact, but changes the movement vocabulary, spatial attitude and body-state emphasis.
